idempiere.Description: REST API v2 MFA authentication challenge storage
idempiere.Author: Casa del Software

SQLMandatory.statement: CREATE TABLE REST_AuthChallenge ( REST_AuthChallenge_UU VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, AD_Client_ID NUMERIC(10) NOT NULL, AD_Org_ID NUMERIC(10) NOT NULL, IsActive CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'Y' NOT NULL, Created TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, CreatedBy NUMERIC(10) NOT NULL, Updated TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, UpdatedBy NUMERIC(10) NOT NULL, TokenHash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, AD_User_ID NUMERIC(10) NOT NULL, UserName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, AllowedClients VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, ClientParameter VARCHAR(255), RoleParameter VARCHAR(255), OrgParameter VARCHAR(255), WarehouseParameter VARCHAR(255), Language VARCHAR(10), ExpiresAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, AttemptCount NUMERIC(10) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, ConsumedAt TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT REST_AuthChallenge_Key PRIMARY KEY (REST_AuthChallenge_UU), CONSTRAINT REST_AuthChallenge_Token_UQ UNIQUE (TokenHash) )
CREATE INDEX REST_AuthChallenge_Expiry ON REST_AuthChallenge (ExpiresAt, IsActive)
